logChanges.name: Log Changes to Chat
logChanges.hint: If enabled, sends a whisper to the GM whenever an Adversary is updated via the Manager.

autoExperiences.name: Auto-Update Experiences
autoExperiences.hint: If enabled, experiences will increase/decrease by 1 for each Tier change.

suggestFeatures.name: Show New Features Panel
suggestFeatures.hint: If enabled, the Live Manager preview lists the features available for the target tier and type, so you can tick the ones to add.

importFolder.name: Compendium Import Folder
importFolder.hint: Name of the folder where adversaries imported from Compendiums will be created.

encounterFolder.name: Encounter Folder Name
encounterFolder.hint: Name of the root folder where encounters created by the builder will be stored.
